description: Read one Academy training module in full — body, learning objectives and summary, EN, FR and DE — the written course corpus the Consultant web plan sells. On THIS endpoint the paid tranche is opened by the MCP Pass (€29.90/month, analyticslegends.ai/mcp-server/) or the Firm Pass; the Consultant and Legend web plans do not include MCP access. Requires an API key of an MCP Pass or Firm account (Authorization: Bearer alk_…); without one this tool refuses and `find_academy_modules` keeps serving the catalogue. Takes the module id (`M001`) or its slug (`datasphere-foundations`), both matched case-insensitively — `find_academy_modules` returns both on every row, and `query_knowledge_graph` returns the same ids as `module:M001` node ids, so a graph walk now ENDS somewhere. The module is served in one call. `lang` (en · fr · de) returns that language only; without it the three languages come back together — EXCEPT when the three would exceed the response ceiling (the Datasphere foundations course M001, rewritten as a full training on 2026-10-28, weighs 423 KB in three languages): the English text is then served alone and `filters.lang` says so — call again with lang=fr or lang=de for the other two.

id.description: Module id (`M001`) or slug (`datasphere-foundations`), verbatim from find_academy_modules.rows[].id / .slug.

lang.description: Serve this language only. Omit it to get all three, unless they would exceed the response ceiling — then English alone is served and filters.lang says so.

name: get_academy_module

objectives_en.description: Learning objectives, one per element — a text[] column, not a paragraph.

title: Read an Academy module (Consultant tier)
